name: steam-controller
description: Let Claude see and play Steam games on Windows: library and launch, screenshots, keyboard/mouse input, and a Source engine adapter (Portal, Half-Life 2).
long_description: Generic layer for any Steam game: list and launch your library, capture the game window, and send timed keyboard/mouse input (only while the game is the foreground window; sequences abort if you click away). Source engine games such as Portal additionally get a console bridge for exact position and view angles, aiming to the degree, console commands, and pausing the world while Claude thinks. Games that ship detectable anti-cheat are refused; do not use it for online multiplayer.

tools.name: steam_list_games
tools.description: List installed Steam games, Source engine detection and anti-cheat flags.

tools.name: steam_launch
tools.description: Launch a game through Steam and attach to its window.

tools.name: game_attach
tools.description: Attach to a running game window by appid or title.

tools.name: game_act
tools.description: Run a timed keyboard/mouse sequence, then screenshot.

tools.name: game_release_all
tools.description: Release all held keys and mouse buttons.

tools.name: source_launch
tools.description: Launch a Source engine game with the console bridge, optionally into a map.

tools.name: source_console
tools.description: Run Source console commands and return their output.

tools.name: source_status
tools.description: Exact player position, view angles and map.

tools.name: source_look
tools.description: Turn the view by exact degrees or to an absolute heading.

tools.name: source_goto
tools.description: Walk to map coordinates with live position feedback.

tools.name: source_panorama
tools.description: Four labelled views (ahead/right/left/behind) in one image.

tools.name: source_pause
tools.description: Freeze or resume the game world.
